answer: Go to the Tickets page and click the Raise Ticket button. Fill in the Title, Description, Product and Priority, then click Save.
Currently tickets cannot be deleted from the application. Only Admin users can manage ticket updates.
Only Admin users can edit tickets, assign them and update their status.
Ticket status can only be updated by an Admin. Available statuses are Open, Assigned, In Progress, Resolved and Closed.
Only Admin users can assign tickets to employees.
Go to the Products page and click Add Product. Fill in the product details including category, costs, quantity and description.
Products can be edited from the Products page using the Edit button.
Categories are used to organize products. You can add a category from the Categories page.
Categories can be updated from the Categories page using the Edit option.
The Dashboard displays total products, categories, stock quantity and recently added products.
The Users page displays all registered users along with their roles.
Admin users have full access to manage products, categories and tickets. Normal users can raise tickets and view application data according to their permissions.
Use your registered email and password to log into the Company Inventory application.
Use the Register page to create a new account by entering your name, email and password.
Every management page contains a search box that allows you to quickly find records.
The application uses pagination to display records page by page. Use the Next and Previous buttons to navigate.
Stock quantity represents the available inventory for each product.
Each product stores Material Cost and Service Cost. Total Cost is calculated from these values.
The application automatically records who created or updated records.
